verdict: Leads are coming in steady; Google's tracking gap is being fixed now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 30 leads at a cost of $52.64 per lead, all attributed through Meta, while $979.73 in Google Ads spend ran in parallel. Google Ads is producing activity but a conversion tracking gap means those leads are not being counted — that repair is underway and will give you a complete picture next period. Your Google Business Profiles drove 123 actions this period, including 15 calls and 78 direction requests, though engagement dropped sharply in the final three days of the window, which we are actively monitoring. Ad spend is pacing at $56.22 per day this week, up modestly, but the full scale-up planned for this month depends on several overdue setup items that are being pushed to completion now.

watch_item.issue: Google Ads conversion tracking is not recording leads, so roughly $980 in spend this period has no lead count attached to it.
watch_item.fix: The tracking pixel is being repaired now; the next report will reflect Google leads accurately and show the true combined cost per lead.
